question: Calculate the value of Closing Stock using the FIFO method. Opening Stock: 407 units @ R68. Batch 1 Purchases: 450 units @ R79. Batch 2 Purchases: 520 units @ R86. Total units sold: 456.
explanation: Closing units = 921. Under FIFO, 520 come from Batch 2 (R86) and 401 from Batch 1 (R79). Value = (R44,720) + (R31,679) = R76,399.

question: Calculate Closing Stock value using the Weighted Average method. Opening Stock: 900 units @ R87. Purchases: 509 units @ R107. Carriage on purchases: R2379. Total units sold: 674.
explanation: Total Value = (R78,300) + (R54,463) + Carriage(R2379) = R135,142. Total Units = 1409. WAP = R135,142 / 1409 = R95.91. Closing Stock Value = 735 units x R95.91 = R70,496.36.
